_comment: ATS host registry for src/apply/ats-detect.js (classifyApplyUrl, apply pipeline slice 2). List-based host matching only. Workday's tenant.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com hostname shape and Dayforce's /CandidatePortal/<lang>/<client>/Posting/View/<id> path shape are pinned directly in ats-detect.js (spec-adversary amendment S4), never config-driven, so an edit here alone can never loosen either match. Greenhouse and Lever host lists are copied verbatim from src/core/normalize.js's production host lists (amendment S3/S8); keep the two in sync if normalize.js's lists ever change. myworkdaysite.com is explicitly NOT Workday (see the comment on WORKDAY_HOST_RE in ats-detect.js); do not add it below.
